# Cherokee Nation Language Department

> Official resource for Cherokee language education, immersion programs, translation services, and digital tools supporting the preservation and revitalization of the Cherokee language.

The Cherokee Nation Language Department provides comprehensive language services including immersion schools, formal classes, professional translation, and digital resources. The department supports tribal language preservation efforts through educational programs, technical localization, and community events.

## Key Topics

- Cherokee language
- Language immersion
- Language education
- Cherokee Nation
